mainEntity.name: How can I prevent drywall damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing drywall damage involves several key practices. Maintain consistent indoor humidity levels, especially in bathrooms and kitchens, using exhaust fans to prevent moisture buildup. Address plumbing leaks promptly to avoid water damage. Protect walls from impact in high-traffic areas or behind doors with doorstops. Ensure proper ventilation in attics and crawl spaces to prevent condensation. Regularly check for and repair minor issues like nail pops or hairline cracks before they worsen. Proper insulation can also help mitigate temperature fluctuations that might affect drywall integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent drywall damage by controlling humidity, fixing leaks quickly, protecting walls from impacts, ensuring good ventilation, and addressing minor issues promptly.
